technology_name: ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE-ASSISTED CONTOURING SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR ORGANS AT RISK IN COMPUTED TOMOGRAPHY IMAGES
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Manually tracing the boundaries of fragile organs-at-risk (OAR) across multi-slice computed tomography scans takes extended oncology hours and introduces dangerous high-variance human errors during planning.
description: A high-speed medical software application containing a DICOM image preprocessing script, an automated neural network segmentation engine, a localized multi-channel anatomical classification loop, and a post-processing verification display.
applications: Radiation therapy planning software suites, hospital radiology workflow engines, clinical oncology automation dashboards, and medical image segmentation networks.
